wool.latest_changelog:
v1.8.3 - 2026-02-12 - Seasonal Greetings

 

===> Before you upgrade from v1.7.x to v1.8.3:

PICKUP all fleece, woolen twine and woolen cloth from the ground or they will be gone!

Compatibility With Other Mods

  • #181 - Add crafting recipe for Tailor's Delight plain checkered cloth from wool cloth, too
  • #180 - Remove accidental doubled recipes for Tailor's Delight mordanted twine
  • #179 - Fix patching saddle blanket recipes when Tailor's Delight is loaded

New Features

  • #175 - Add pastoral shirt and pants recipes, craftable with wool

 

We hope you enjoy our work,

Tels & Phiwa 💜🧡
